sources.takeaway: Paint-support percentiles reduce worst GPU support-loss step from 14.59% to 5.72%; filtering and soft edges prevent an exact area schedule.
Released band fragments move 19.51–36.34 px but look like thin contour wires; reject their shape and use filled original-paint chips.
Filled paint chips avoid wire contours; seven measured centroids travel 20.68–34.71px; the eighth is gone at the late probe and is explicitly unmeasured.
An effect must communicate its gameplay cause clearly and belong to its character; restraint is part of the design.
Curve boundaries and interpolated procedural coordinates can be represented separately on GPU geometry; our strip is tessellated, not the chapter algorithm.
Indexed geometry stores positions and UV attributes explicitly and can reuse strip vertices.
Arc-length-spaced curve sampling differs from uniform parameter values and can stabilize distance-based texture flow.
Equal parameter increments vary in distance by 1.553x; arc-length spacing reduces the ratio to 1.00210 on the same original path.

toolkitSources.readScope: WebGL uniforms, attributes and transparent material settings support seekable shader effects.
Paint is sRGB; noise is data; custom shaders must convert output once.
Transparent overdraw is a pixel cost; off-screen downsampling can create silhouette halos.
Animated sprites carry authored motion; alpha blending restores colour control lost by broad additive layers.
Relative age, velocity and SubUV blending decouple particle appearance from emitter timing.
Value noise maps UV to bounded scalar values; deterministic hash modes avoid platform-varying noise.
Tile index and grid dimensions select atlas UVs; top-left image order requires explicit Y handling.
Velocity-aligned particle stretch is separate from camera stretch and base sprite size.
Texture panning uses explicit time and UV speeds; a scalar offset permits deterministic seeking.
Source-over reduces backdrop by source alpha; premultiplication must be consistent.
Key poses, nonuniform spacing and approximately preserved volume give weight; overlap separates attachments.
Weighted internal vertices and explicit triangles determine how a painted polygon bends; rest pose matters.
A ground-attached transparent plane can anchor flat art cheaply, without repeated shadow-map passes.
The native renderer has weighted vertices, editable clips and independent pose state.
Larger units expose washout and weak wind-up; scale correction is not animation acceptance.
Study directional impulse and ordered fallout; reject reference walk-ups, cinematics and whiteouts.
